description: Illustrative events from the complete 407-sequence time-key audit. Rows: correct-time, time-misbound saved real and time-misbound SimVP AGRI, then their corresponding R-COT fields. Same fixed reflectance stretch; COT uses log colour spacing. White star: station; blue square: 3x3 GHI input. Gray: night/low sun. Curves: same corrected frozen R and mean GHI predictions across three fixed seeds. Invalid time-paired diagnostic outputs, not forecast-performance evidence. Cloud maps are instantaneous; GHI is the preceding 15-min interval mean. Correct-time missing source frames are gaps, never interpolated.
